result.description:
BAM Hay Investment Trust trading as, Oracle Business Accountants are an established Gold Coast accounting practice based in Mermaid Beach seeking a qualified full-time Accountant to join our small, professional team.

Our firm works closely with business and individual clients to thoughtfully manage financial affairs, effectively manage risks, identify opportunities and support long-term growth.

This role involves responsibility for managing a diverse portfolio of clients and delivering a range of high-quality accounting, taxation and advisory services. The successful candidate will contribute to client success by ensuring accurate compliance work as well as being an asset within the firm’s collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Preparation of financial statements and income tax returns for a variety of entities including individuals, companies, trusts and partnerships
- BAS and IAS preparation, review, and lodgement
- Australian taxation compliance and tax planning support
- Ongoing client liaison and advisory support
- Use of cloud accounting software to manage, reconcile and analyse accounts
- Contribute to business advisory and structuring work where required
- Maintain internal workflows and meet key deadlines consistently

Essential Skills & Experience

- 4+ years experience in an Australian public practice accounting role
- assisting in formulating budgetary and accounting policies
- preparing financial statements for presentation to boards of directors, management, shareholders, and governing and statutory bodies
- conducting financial investigations, preparing reports, undertaking audits and advising on matters such as the purchase and sale of businesses, mergers, capital financing, suspected fraud, insolvency and taxation
- examining operating costs and organisations' income and expenditure
- providing assurance about the accuracy of information contained in financial reports and their compliance with statutory requirements
- providing financial and taxation advice on business structures, plans and operations
- preparing taxation returns for individuals and organisations
- liaising with financial institutions and brokers to establish funds management arrangements
- introducing and maintaining accounting systems, and advising on the selection and application of computer-based accounting systems
- maintaining internal control systems
- may appraise cash flow and financial risk of capital investment projects

result.description:
Lead the setup of our customer service operations, focusing on process development, customer journey mapping.    Your new company     At Hays, we believe in being long-term partners with our people, as well as our customers. Together, we will work for your tomorrow, and the possibilities are endless.  With over 50 years of business success, we have built a reputation as the world leader in specialist recruitment and workforce solutions. Joining Hays isn't just being part of a global business leader; we're also the industry leading recruiting experts in Australia. We offer our people a career like no other.      Your new role     We are seeking an Integration Analyst to join the Hays team based in our Melbourne office. This is a full time permanent role commencing immediately. The salary is $113,000 + Super.  Responsibilities   
 
 Design and improve customer sales and service processes to deliver a seamless and efficient customer experience.   
 Serve as the subject matter expert for renewable energy solutions, translating complex technical information into clear and practical guidance.   
 Analyse and map customer journeys, identifying opportunities to enhance service delivery, customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.   
 Manage customer enquiries and escalations, ensuring timely resolution and coordination across internal teams and external partners.   
 Develop training materials, documentation and standard operating procedures to support both customers and internal stakeholders.   
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support the successful delivery and adoption of solar, battery, EV charging and other consumer energy solutions.     
 
  What you'll need to succeed     
 
 Experience in customer service, customer success, operations or process improvement, ideally within the renewable energy, utilities or technology sector.   
 Strong understanding of consumer energy solutions, including solar, battery storage, EV charging and other emerging energy technologies.   
 Proven ability to analyse and improve business processes, customer journeys and service delivery outcomes.   
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a simple and engaging way.   
 Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and drive continuous improvement.   
 Customer-focused mindset with experience using CRM systems and a passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.      What you need to do now  
 
 If you're thinking of a new tomorrow for your career, let's work together to create it.  Contact Sandy Luhr, Senior Talent Acquisition Partner by submitting your application via the Apply Now button.  By joining Hays, you'll be part of an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity. We invite people of all genders, ages, cultures, abilities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. This includes Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people who belong to LGBTQIA+ community, neurodiverse individuals, and people with disabilities. If you require support and/or adjustments throughout our recruitment process please contact recruitment.anz@hays.com.au       Please  click here  to apply.
